module_summary: N:1 Ethernet frame arbitrated mux: an arbiter grants one input per frame, header fields are latched into output registers, and the granted payload stream is muxed through a skid-buffered output register stage.

anchors.name: grant_encoded
anchors.why: Encoded granted input index; selects header fields and payload stream from that input.

anchors.name: frame_reg
anchors.why: Two-state idle/in-frame tracker: starts frame on grant, clears on tlast.

anchors.name: s_eth_hdr_valid
anchors.why: Per-input header valid vector forming arbiter requests.

anchors.name: s_eth_payload_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Concatenated input payload streams muxed by grant_encoded.

anchors.name: m_eth_payload_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Registered output payload data of the selected frame.

anchors.name: grant
anchors.why: One-hot grant from arbiter; masks requests and drives header ready.

anchors.name: grant_valid
anchors.why: A grant is active; gates frame start, payload valid and input ready.

anchors.name: m_eth_hdr_valid
anchors.why: Output header valid, set at frame start and cleared by m_eth_hdr_ready.

anchors.name: m_eth_dest_mac_reg
anchors.why: Holds selected input header fields (dest MAC representative) for output header.

anchors.name: s_eth_payload_axis_tready
anchors.why: Ready routed only to granted input when output path can accept.

anchors.name: m_eth_payload_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: Output payload valid from skid output register.

anchors.name: m_eth_payload_axis_tready
anchors.why: Downstream ready; steers output vs temp register storage.

anchors.name: request
anchors.why: Arbiter request vector from header valids masked by current grant.

anchors.name: acknowledge
anchors.why: Releases grant at last payload beat of granted input.

anchors.name: s_eth_hdr_ready
anchors.why: Header accept pulse to granted input at frame start.

anchors.name: current_s_tdata
anchors.why: Muxed payload data of granted input into internal datapath.

anchors.name: m_eth_payload_axis_tready_int_reg
anchors.why: Registered internal ready gating input ready and skid buffer storage decisions.

anchors.name: temp_m_eth_payload_axis_tdata_reg
anchors.why: Skid temp register holding payload beat when output stalls.

anchors.name: temp_m_eth_payload_axis_tvalid_reg
anchors.why: Temp skid register occupied flag; affects early ready.

anchors.name: store_axis_int_to_output
anchors.why: Loads output registers from internal datapath.

anchors.name: store_axis_int_to_temp
anchors.why: Loads temp skid registers when output not ready.

anchors.name: store_eth_payload_axis_temp_to_output
anchors.why: Moves temp skid registers into output registers.

groups.name: Arbiter and frame control
groups.description: Arbiter grants one input per frame; frame_reg tracks frame boundaries and acknowledges on tlast.

groups.name: Header register
groups.description: Latches granted input header fields into output header registers with valid/ready.

groups.name: Payload mux
groups.description: Selects granted input payload stream into internal datapath.

groups.name: Output skid buffer
groups.description: Output plus temp register pair giving registered ready on payload output.
